lines.say: Cutting an onion makes you cry, and it's a chemical trap.
lines.caption: Trap

lines.say: Every slice rips open thousands of tiny cells.
lines.caption: Cells

lines.say: Two chemicals that were kept apart mix, and an enzyme turns them into a gas.
lines.caption: Gas

lines.say: That gas drifts up and stings the nerves in your eyes.
lines.caption: Eyes

lines.say: So your tear glands flood the eye to wash it away.
lines.caption: Tears

lines.say: Tip: chill the onion and use a sharp knife. Less gas, fewer tears.
lines.caption: Tip
